description.value:
You are keenly aware of secret communities that revolve around drachiri or other dragonkind, and can take great steps in ensuring you are not the loose lip that sinks that ship. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to DCs to Gather Information for any of your own personal inquiries (including when you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.uF0ATN2Zw1Q67ew2]{Discreet Inquiry}) or to your Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.plBGdZhqq5JBl1D8]{Gather Information} (or Society checks for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise}), or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} creatures (including for @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.IyJyZ1VQxS58Nk6V]{Eyes of the City}) when it pertains to dragon-related topics, communities or culture.

If you belong to a group that has relevance to dragonkind, you automatically recognize members of those groups unless they are specifically attempting to conceal their presence to you. They also recognize you and your standing unless you are specifically concealing it.
